changes.what: D1: replaced HP-subtract with soak-accumulate (soak 0->100, derived hp = 100 - soak); down emitted at soak >= 100; added soak field to addPlayer + resets in start()/_nextRound.
changes.why: Make soak the single win condition for BOTH weapon families. Kills the one-tap saber and the HP/soak double-bookkeeping; the existing HUD already renders soak = 100 - hp, so it stays honest with zero HUD rework.

changes.what: D2: leafblade.soak 100 -> 34, blurb updated to 'three clean touches'.
changes.why: Saber was deleting full-HP foes in one swing. At 34 soak, three clean hits bubble a foe; saber and projectiles now share one bar.

changes.what: D2: saber now spends stamina per swing (cost 0.34, regen 0.42/s, swing blocked + 'Winded' when empty); early-swing connect (saber.swing <= 0.45) deals 1.5x soak (timing reward); whiff past 0.7 sets a recoverable 'Exposed!' opening; synced this.soak on damage/down/heal events.
changes.why: Give the saber a melee identity of movement+timing commitment (the lead's BOTH split) without touching movement physics.

changes.what: D3: botShoot now fires the player's own kit (leafblade melee at <=3.4m, petalbow ranged otherwise) using TOOLS soak values; removed the legacy WEAPON/applySpread/traceShot carbine import.
changes.why: Bots were a third, invisible archetype with a gun players never touch. Now the AI trains against the exact numbers you ship.
